notes:
### New

- Dress your explorer. The new Explorer tab on the dashboard has your explorer turning in a preview: choose a body, a face, a hair style, a shirt, pants and a sweater, and a colour for each. Try things on, then Apply to keep them or Revert to drop them. Watch them walk, run, crouch or crawl in the preview before you go down.
- Everyone sees your look below, and you see theirs, so you can finally tell who is who in the dark.
- The Expedition page shows your party standing together in their looks, you in front, each waiting in their own way until everyone is ready.

### Changes

- Loadout has moved from a dashboard tab to a pill beside Credits. It still opens with Tab (View on a controller).

### Fixes

- Turning your lamp on in Rumors no longer throws an error.
